title: A fish sorting scan detection measurement
description: The result of a measurement scan to sort fish by species and weight using images, video frames or other sensor data

identifier.description: The unique identifier for the fish sorting scan

start_datetime.description: The date and time the fish sorting scan started in UTC in RFC3339 format

end_datetime.description: The date and time the fish sorting scan ended in UTC in RFC3339 format

spatial_data.description: The spatial data of the fish in the detection source

bounding_box.description: The bounding box of the fish in the image

items.description: The detected bounding box of the fish in the detection source

polygons.description: The polygons of the fish in the image

items.description: The detected polygon of the fish in the detection source
The detected polygon point of the fish in the detection source

below_minimum_size.description: Indicates the fish is below the minimum measurement size

occlusion_type.description: The detected occlusion type of the fish in the image

fish.description: All the details related to the detected fish in this scan

condition_score.description: The condition score of the fish on a scale from 1 to 10

estimated_age.description: The estimated age of the fish in years

length.description: The detected length of the fish in meters

species_code.description: The type of fish species. This is a 3-letter FAO fish species code

species_confidence.description: The confidence score for the detection of the fish species and weight in the image

sex.description: The detected sex of the fish

weight.description: The measured, estimated or calculated weight of the fish

validation.description: The validation details of the fish sorting detection

actor.description: The actor performing the validation, e.g. machine or human

status.description: The validation status of the fish sorting detection
